_comment: Astra Militarum citations (iter-14). Covers the Combined Arms detachment rule (Born Soldiers), the Voice of Command army-wide Order economy, the four wired Officer Orders (Take Aim!, Fix Bayonets!, FRFSRF, Take Cover!), and the six Combined Arms detachment stratagems (Coordinated Action, Reinforcements!, Flexible Command, Fields of Fire, Inspired Command, Stalwart Protector). All entries cite the Wahapedia AM faction page; per-stratagem quoted_text fields are codex-verbatim quotes captured from the Wahapedia detachment block.

COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.quoted_text: Each time a model in a REGIMENT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a SQUADRON unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.trigger: any ranged attack made by a friendly AM REGIMENT (vs non-VEHICLE/MONSTER target) OR SQUADRON (vs VEHICLE/MONSTER target)
COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.effect: the attack gains [LETHAL HITS] (Critical Hits auto-wound). Simulator gate: Unit.attack's `effective_lethal_hits` branch ORs in True when faction is Astra Militarum, mode is ranged, and the REGIMENT-vs-non-V/M or SQUADRON-vs-V/M matrix matches. APPROXIMATION: BSData v10.6.0 doesn't tag datasheets with the codex's REGIMENT / SQUADRON keywords. AM-DIAG-2 (2026-05-24) narrowed the REGIMENT proxy from INFANTRY → BATTLELINE after the INFANTRY mapping was found to over-grant LETHAL HITS to 40+ non-REGIMENT INFANTRY units (Tempestus Scions / Kasrkin / Aquilons / Ratlings / Ogryns / Bullgryns / Commissars / Yarrick / Tech-Priests / Sly Marbo / Ursula Creed / Cadian Castellan / Lord Solar Leontus / Command Squads / Heavy Weapons Squads / Inquisition agents). BATTLELINE catches the three core REGIMENT troops the rule was written for (Cadian Shock Troops, Catachan Jungle Fighters, Death Korps of Krieg); it does under-cover a few non-BATTLELINE REGIMENT squads (Heavy Weapons Squads / Command Squads) but this is the much smaller error. SQUADRON → attacker has VEHICLE is unchanged

COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.rule_name: Born Soldiers (Combined Arms Detachment Rule) — alias
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.quoted_text: Each time a model in a REGIMENT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a SQUADRON unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.trigger: any ranged attack made by a friendly AM REGIMENT (vs non-VEHICLE/MONSTER target) OR SQUADRON (vs VEHICLE/MONSTER target)
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.effect: alias of COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hits — both module-level symbols (COMBINED_REGIMENT, COMBINED_ARMS) point to the same Detachment instance after the iter-14 codex-name rename. See the COMBINED_REGIMENT.* entry above for the full effect notes; this duplicate citation exists because the rule auditor scans dir(det_module) and finds both symbol names

simulator.voice_of_command_orders.rule_name: Voice of Command (Astra Militarum Army Rule)
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM, OFFICER models with this ability can issue Orders. Each OFFICER's datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those Orders.
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.trigger: start of each Command phase, on each alive AM OFFICER datasheet (per `code.orders.AM_OFFICER_NAMES` allowlist) within 6" of an eligible BATTLELINE INFANTRY target
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.effect: each Officer issues Orders to its codex-permitted target types within 6", up to the per-Officer count in `code.orders.OFFICER_ORDER_PROFILES`. Each Order applies a single transient buff for the round (Take Aim! / Fix Bayonets! / First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! / Take Cover!). No Order stacking — a unit holds at most one Order per round. Battle-shocked Officers and Battle-shocked targets are excluded. Wired in `code/orders.py`; called from `Battle._run_round` after the per-round command point drip and stratagem dispatch. Wave 237: per-Officer target-type restriction is now fully enforced — `OFFICER_ORDER_PROFILES` maps every Officer to (max_orders, frozenset of target-type keyword categories) sourced from the BSData Library Astra Militarum cache. The dispatcher filters each Officer's target pool by its own restriction (REGIMENT=BATTLELINE INFANTRY / SQUADRON=BATTLELINE VEHICLE / TITANIC=TITANIC keyword). The Flexible Command (Combined Arms, 2 command points) stratagem OR-widens the eligible-target set to include BATTLELINE VEHICLE (SQUADRON) for the round it fires, independently of per-Officer limits. Lord Solar Leontus's Orders profile (BSData cat.gz unit id a9d-55c1-3d24-fa25, Orders profile id 4768-11ce-3c8b-3ce4; cross-checked Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/astra-militarum/Lord-Solar-Leontus) allows REGIMENT, SQUADRON, TITANIC at 3 Orders per round. Issuer gate narrowed (AM-DIAG, 2026-05-24): previously the dispatcher accepted ANY AM CHARACTER as an Order issuer, which mis-treated Commissar / Yarrick / Graves / Ministorum Priest / Tech-Priest Enginseer / Primaris Psyker / Nork Deddog / Ogryn Bodyguard / Sly Marbo / Straken / Harker / Gaunt's Ghosts / Hell's Last / Rein and Raus / Quartermaster / Death Rider Commissar as Officers. The new gate (`AM_OFFICER_NAMES`) is the Wahapedia OFFICER-keyword allowlist, populated by reading each AM CHARACTER datasheet's keyword line

Order.Take Aim!.quoted_text: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.Take Aim!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible BATTLELINE INFANTRY target within 6"
Order.Take Aim!.effect: sets `Unit.transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the target for the round (Unit.attack reads the flag and applies +1 to the ranged Hit roll). CLEAN MAPPING — codex 'improve BS by 1' is arithmetically identical to '+1 to hit roll' at every BS bracket. The AI picks this Order when the target has no other Order yet and has lower ranged DPA than the FRFSRF threshold (fallback)

Order.Fix Bayonets!.quoted_text: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.Fix Bayonets!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible BATTLELINE INFANTRY target within 6"
Order.Fix Bayonets!.effect: (APPROXIMATION) routes the offensive payoff through `Unit.transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the target for the round — codex effect is 'improve WS by 1' (a melee hit-roll buff) but SwegHammer's existing transient layer has no per-unit +1-to-hit-melee flag, so we proxy through +1 to wound to capture the offensive payoff via a single existing transient. Same direction (more landed melee damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ wound roll. The AI picks Fix Bayonets! when the target has meaningful melee DPA AND low ranged DPA (Ogryns / Bullgryns canonical) — Lasgun-block Cadians take FRFSRF instead

Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.rule_name: First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! (Astra Militarum Order)
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.quoted_text: Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible BATTLELINE INFANTRY target within 6"
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.effect: FAITHFUL MAPPING (wave 236 NE-2): sets `Unit.transient_frfsrf_active` on the target for the round. The codex text has no range condition; Unit.compute_expected_kills reads the flag and adds +1 to n_attacks for every weapon profile with rapid_fire > 0, unconditionally at all ranges (the existing half-range Rapid Fire X bonus at line ~2010 is separate and unchanged). Cross-checked: Wahapedia AM faction page + BSData Library cat.gz both carry the verbatim text above. The AI picks FRFSRF as the canonical Lasgun-block Order — any BATTLELINE INFANTRY with real ranged DPA (>= 0.5) qualifies.

Order.Take Cover!.quoted_text: Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model's Save to better than 3+).
Order.Take Cover!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible BATTLELINE INFANTRY target within 6"
Order.Take Cover!.effect: sets `Unit.transient_plus_one_save` on the target for the round (Unit.attack reads the flag when computing save_after_ap and lowers the save target by 1, capped at 2+ via the existing transient_plus_one_save plumbing). APPROXIMATION: the codex caps at 3+, SwegHammer's flag caps at 2+ — the wider cap rarely binds for AM BATTLELINE INFANTRY (saves are 5+/4+ across Cadians/Krieg/Catachan/Kasrkin/Scions). The AI picks Take Cover! when the target has lost more than 20% of starting HP (defensive priority)

Stratagem.Coordinated Action.quoted_text: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
Stratagem.Coordinated Action.trigger: start of any phase, on a REGIMENT + SQUADRON pair within 6" of and visible to each other
Stratagem.Coordinated Action.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator routes the offensive payoff through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA AM SQUADRON (VEHICLE) for the round — the canonical use case is extending Take Aim! from an Infantry Squad to a Leman Russ pair, which the +1-to-hit-shooting proxy captures exactly. The two-unit-pair gate is collapsed to 'apply the buff directly to the SQUADRON' since the simulator's Order economy doesn't expose a 'mirror Order to another unit' hook. Direction-correct; same lossy pattern as Mont'ka Focused Fire. 1 CP per Combined Arms. AM-DIAG-4 (2026-05-24): added anti-stack guard — dispatcher now skips fire if the chosen SQUADRON already holds any transient Order buff for the round (matches the codex no-op behaviour when mirroring an Order onto a unit that already holds it).

Stratagem.Reinforcements!.quoted_text: WHEN: Any phase. TARGET: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
Stratagem.Reinforcements!.trigger: any phase, when an INFANTRY REGIMENT unit is just destroyed (once per battle)
Stratagem.Reinforcements!.effect: (APPROXIMATION — catalogued-but-no-op) SwegHammer has no mid-battle unit-respawn / Strategic-Reserve injection primitive, so the dispatcher exits without spending CP or returning a unit to play. The stratagem entry is retained in COMBINED_ARMS_STRATAGEMS so the rule auditor lists the full six-stratagem set and the AI never accidentally substitutes a Core Stratagem for it. 2 CP per Combined Arms, once per battle. Wahapedia confirms the once-per-battle gate via the cumbersome respawn — implementation deferred behind the simulator's reserve-injection refactor

Stratagem.Flexible Command.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
Stratagem.Flexible Command.trigger: your Command phase, on any number of AM OFFICER units
Stratagem.Flexible Command.effect: CLEAN MAPPING: sets `Army.orders_eligible_squadron_this_round = True` for the round, which `code.orders._is_order_target_eligible` reads when filtering the target pool for Order issuance. Stratagem dispatch runs BEFORE Order dispatch in `Battle._run_round`, so the flag is honoured by the same-round Order issuance — AM SQUADRON (BATTLELINE VEHICLE) units like Leman Russ Battle Tank become eligible to receive Orders (typically Take Aim! / FRFSRF). 2 CP per Combined Arms

Stratagem.Fields of Fire.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot. EFFECT: Each time your selected units make an attack targeting that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Stratagem.Fields of Fire.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a REGIMENT + SQUADRON pair vs a chosen enemy unit
Stratagem.Fields of Fire.effect: (APPROXIMATION) routes the offensive payoff through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-ranged-DPA AM unit (any keyword) for the round — the AP+1 codex effect translates as 'more landed wounds get through saves'; +1 to hit is the closest single-flag proxy that produces the same direction of damage swing. The two-unit-pair gate is collapsed to 'apply the buff to the highest-DPA AM unit'. Same lossy pattern as Mont'ka Focused Fire / Custodes Archaeotech Munitions. 1 CP per Combined Arms. AM-DIAG-4 (2026-05-24): the highest-DPA picker now filters out units that already hold `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` from a prior Order / Coordinated Action this round. This prevents the dispatcher from spending CP to re-set an idempotent boolean (no-op) and narrows the per-round magnitude to a single extra shooter.

Stratagem.Inspired Command.quoted_text: WHEN: Your opponent's Command phase. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army. EFFECT: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
Stratagem.Inspired Command.trigger: your opponent's Command phase, on one AM OFFICER unit
Stratagem.Inspired Command.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator's Order dispatch is a single-pass round-start hook (not tied to opponent's Command phase specifically), so 'opponent's Command phase Order' maps onto 'issue one extra Order this round'. The dispatcher picks an un-buffed REGIMENT in aura of any AM Officer and applies the AI's chosen Order (Take Aim! / Fix Bayonets! / FRFSRF / Take Cover!) to it. Direction-correct (extra Order economy); the timing detail (codex fires in opponent's turn, allowing reactive Take Cover!) is dropped since SwegHammer applies the Order in the same-round dispatch. 1 CP per Combined Arms

Stratagem.Stalwart Protector.quoted_text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army. EFFECT: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover.
Stratagem.Stalwart Protector.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase after target selection, on one AM VEHICLE unit
Stratagem.Stalwart Protector.effect: CLEAN MAPPING (with approximate eligibility): routes the defensive payoff through `transient_plus_one_save` on the most-vulnerable AM INFANTRY unit for the round (Benefit of Cover = +1 to save). APPROXIMATION: the 'not fully visible because of your VEHICLE' visibility check is dropped — the simulator's LoS-by-blocker plumbing doesn't expose per-friendly-blocker visibility data at attack time. The dispatcher gates on 'AM army has at least one alive VEHICLE' to match the codex pre-requisite, then applies the +1-save flag to the chosen INFANTRY target. 1 CP per Combined Arms. AM-DIAG-4 (2026-05-24): added anti-stack guard — dispatcher now skips fire if the target already holds `transient_plus_one_save` from Take Cover! Order this round (Benefit of Cover does not stack with itself per codex, and the proxy boolean was masking magnitude-amplification when both fired on the same INFANTRY unit).
